UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores Aashvik AI user preferences, terms acceptance, and moderation/ban standing.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this profile.

displayName.description: User display name shown in the greeting and drawer.

email.description: User Google email address (readable only by owner and verified admin).

termsAccepted.description: Whether the user has accepted the Terms of Service and Violation Policy.

termsAcceptedVersion.description: Accepted Terms & Violation Policy version string.

moderationStatus.description: Account standing. Automatically transitions to 'banned' on policy violations; only verified admin can restore.

banReason.description: Optional reason recorded when an account is permanently banned.

warningCount.description: Number of policy violations/warnings recorded on the account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: A synced Aashvik AI conversation thread belonging to a user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this conversation.

title.description: Conversation title derived from first prompt or user rename.

lastMessagePreview.description: Short preview of the latest message in the thread.

messageCount.description: Total number of messages in this conversation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when conversation was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when conversation was last active (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: An individual user or Aashvik AI message within a conversation.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this message.

attachmentName.description: Optional attached file or image name.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was sent (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SafetyPolicy.title: SafetyPolicy
SafetyPolicy.description: Admin-managed global AI safety training directives and content filtering rules.

strictModeEnabled.description: Whether strictest model safety thresholds (LOW_AND_ABOVE) and prompt guardrails are enforced.

autoFlagViolations.description: Whether blocked prompts/responses are automatically logged for admin review.

blockedKeywords.description: Admin-defined list of custom blocked keywords or phrases.

customSafetyDirectives.description: Additional safety instructions injected into the Aashvik AI system prompt.

updatedBy.description: Email of the verified admin who updated the safety policy.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when safety policy was last updated.

SafetyViolation.title: SafetyViolation
SafetyViolation.description: Automatically logged AI safety policy violation event for admin moderation.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID that triggered the guardrail or safety block.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the safety trigger.

promptSnippet.description: Truncated snippet of the offending prompt for review.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when violation was logged.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when violation was last updated.

ViolationReport.title: ViolationReport
ViolationReport.description: User-submitted report of a policy violation, unsafe response, or abuse.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID submitting the report.

description.description: Detailed report description provided by the user.

adminNotes.description: Optional resolution notes added by the admin.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when report was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when report was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user synced settings, terms acceptance, and moderation/ban standing.

/users/{userId}/conversations/{conversat.description: Ordered messages inside a synced conversation.

/safety_policies/{policyId}.description: Global AI safety training configuration managed by verified admin.

/safety_violations/{violationId}.description: Auto-flagged AI safety violation log entries for admin moderation.

/violation_reports/{reportId}.description: User-submitted policy and safety violation reports.
